text.tspan: Fertility rate among women aged 50 to 54

The
age-specific fertility rate
for women aged 50 to 54, measured as the number of live births per 1,000 women

in this age group. Future projections are based on the
UN's high scenario
.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
